'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Eurovision Song Contest 2026]]
**[[Ireland in the Eurovision Song Contest|Ireland]], [[Slovenia in the Eurovision Song Contest|Slovenia]], [[Spain in the Eurovision Song Contest|Spain]], and the [[Netherlands in the Eurovision Song Contest|Netherlands]] announce they will boycott next year's [[Eurovision Song Contest]] after the [[European Broadcasting Union]] confirmed [[Israel in the Eurovision Song Contest|Israel]]'s participation. '''International relations'''
*[[Russia–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal]]
***The [[United Kingdom]] imposes [[Sanctions involving Russia|sanctions]] against [[Russia]]'s [[GRU (Russian Federation)|GRU]] and several [[Main Intelligence Directorate (G.U.)|military intelligence]] officers after a [[List of public inquiries in the United Kingdom|public inquiry]] concludes that Russian operatives carried out the 2018 [[Novichok]] attack in [[Salisbury]], [[Wiltshire]], [[England]], under orders from [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]]. The UK also summons [[List of ambassadors of Russia to the United Kingdom|Russian ambassador]] [[Andrey Kelin]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/uk-sets-out-new-sanctions-against-russia-after-novichok-report-2025-12-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Kenya–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] signs a five-year agreement to provide over $1.6 billion to [[Kenya]]'s [[Healthcare in Kenya|health system]] under its new [[Global health funding by the United States|global health strategy]], with Kenya committing to increase domestic health spending by US$850 million. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/us-signs-pact-with-kenya-under-america-first-global-health-plan-2025-12-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Human trafficking in Spain]]
**[[Spain|Spanish]] [[Law enforcement in Spain|police]] arrest eleven people linked to a criminal network that [[human smuggling|smuggled]] over 300 workers into the country on [[tourist visa]]s, mostly from [[Nepal]], and placed them on farms. [https://apnews.com/article/spain-workers-smuggling-nepal-21ddb9c84927a146515691242f010250 (AP)]
*[[Planning of the January 6 United States Capitol attack#Pipe bomber|Planning of the January 6 United States Capitol attack]]
**A 30-year-old man is arrested and charged with transporting an [[explosive device]] and attempted malicious destruction by means of explosive materials after planting [[pipe bomb]]s near the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] and [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] parties' headquarters in [[Washington, D.C.]], [[United States]], a day before the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|January 6]] attack on the [[United States Capitol]] in 2021. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/suspect-arrested-january-6-dc-pipe-bomb-case-rcna247308 (NBC News)]

**The [[U.S. Supreme Court]] permits [[Texas]] to use its [[Gerrymandering in the United States|redrawn]] [[List of United States congressional districts|congressional map]] for the [[2026 United States elections|2026 midterm elections]], [[Stay of execution|staying]] a [[United States District Court for the District of Columbia|lower court]] ruling that found the plan relied on [[Race and ethnicity in the United States census|racial considerations]].
